Name: Change Horse to Mudsdale
Author: xaandiir
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/JY3h8KR.gif[/img]﻿

[b]WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO[/b]

This mod changes your horse into the pokemon Mudsdale.
This was a request from an user on tumblr.

[b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b]

- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Download and unzip file
- Drop file into your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
- Run game with SMAPI

[u]Feel free to ask if you have any questions![/u][/center][center]
Note: At the moment I'm taking mod requests. Especially pokemon related! Send me a message on here or on my tumblr (@xaandiir or @meadows-farm) and I'll try to get to them :)

I hope to make more Pokemon mods in the future.[/center]
